sasha: Heads-up — found a subtle HF->Redwood tokenizer mismatch while onboarding the spm model for convo-agent. token ids for the placeholder token ended up shifted after our conversion pipeline.
leo: Ugh. Is this the usual special-token offset problem or something else?
sasha: Not the usual pad/cls offsets. This looks tied to SentencePiece suffix pieces that collide with BPE merge ordering. Repro steps: run spm export to vocab+model, then our script that generates merges.txt by sorting by frequency — that step reorders some suffix pieces so special token indices move.
sasha: Quick repro (python):
```
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
t = Tokenizer.from_file('converted-bpe.json')
assert t.token_to_id('<placeholder>') == expected_id  # FAILS: got expected_id+2
```
tim: can you paste the small diff of token ids? :face_with_monocle:
sasha: sure — before conversion (spm): `<placeholder>` -> 5021. After our bpe artifact: `<placeholder>` -> 5023. Two ids higher. Also noticed `<s>` / `</s>` stayed but some suffixlike pieces like `▁ing` got new ids ahead of reserved range.
leo: hmm. sounds like when we merge we append merged tokens at the end and then rebuild vocab order by frequency, which can push reserved tokens unless we explicitly keep special tokens first.
sasha: exactly. The conversion tool we used (third_party/sentencepiece_to_bpe.py) does not anchor special tokens at the front. Plus there's an NF* normalization step difference: HF tokenizers normalize to NFKC by default sometimes. I saw a couple of multi-codepoint characters were normalized earlier in the pipeline, changing counts and hence ordering.
infra-bot: deploy-check: tokenizer integration tests FAILED for convo-agent on staging (2 regressions)
leo: action items: (1) short-term patch — force-map special tokens to the original ids before writing tokenizer files; (2) medium-term — update conversion script to preserve special token order and run normalization consistently; (3) add unit test covering placeholder id stability.
tim: for (1) we can inject a postprocess step: load bpe vocab, find special tokens from spm model (via sentencepiece proto), then rebuild id map: specials -> original indices; remaining tokens compacted after. Should be fast.
sasha: I'll open a quick PR with the postprocess step and a failing unit test that asserts id equality across conversion. test will run on CI and also compute a token-diff report.
sasha: minimal failing test to include in PR:
```
# tests/test_spm_bpe_id_stability.py
old_ids = load_spm_reserved_ids('orig.model')
new_ids = load_converted_reserved_ids('converted.json')
for t in old_ids:
    assert new_ids[t] == old_ids[t]
```
leo: also check normalization: add `sentencepiece.SentencePieceProcessor().SetEncodeExtraOptions('NFKC')` or run `unicodedata.normalize('NFKC', text)` at token counting stage so counts match.
tim: good call. one more gotcha — some HF chat templates expect specific token ids for `</s>` and `</s_extra>` variants. we should add those to the reserved list so no accidental reordering.
sasha: noted. I'll include a small docblock in the conversion script explaining reserved tokens ordering and normalization choice.
leo: thanks. If you want, tag me in the PR and I'll review the mapping code. Also let's add a short integration test that runs a few synthetic prompts and diffs logits to catch silent remaps later.
sasha: will do. adding estimated timeline: hotfix PR today, broader conversion refactor next sprint.
